description: Get daily net flows of every spot ETF on one crypto asset, fund by fund (IBIT, FBTC, ETHA, …), over the last 30 days. Each trading day lists the funds trading that day with ticker, issuer and net USD millions (positive = inflow, negative = outflow), plus `totalUsdM` for the day. `netFlowUsdM` is null when there is no figure for the fund that day, usually because it has not reported yet; 0 means no creations or redemptions. Flows are published one business day in arrears.

asset.description: Asset to fetch: btc, eth, sol, xrp, hyp, doge, link, avax, hbar, ltc, bnb, dot, sui, near, trx, zec

name: get_fund_flows
title: Crypto ETF Flows by Fund
